race.comment: Tough race. HOME TOMURRA (17) ran a solid race first up here in a Class 1 to grab third with improvement to come. Still lightly raced, he'll take holding out from a soft gate with even luck. SUPERLIV (15) is coming off a solid win at Pakenham Synthetic second up. 1100m is no issue and she can give a sight again at big odds with Craig Williams booked. ROYAL RENDEZVOUS (18) looks ready to win third up and Shinn goes on. Drawn wide so not quite sure where he gets to but he can improve again and take holding out. TEN WARRIORS (10) resumes. He's very consistent without winning. 1100m is on the sharper side but he'll run well.
